qs.s: Le candidat ___ a prononcé un discours devant ses partisans.
qs.en: The elected candidate gave a speech before his supporters.

qs.s: La maire ___ a immédiatement commencé à travailler pour la ville.
qs.en: The elected mayor immediately began to work for the city.

qs.s: Les citoyens souhaitent que leurs ___ rendent des comptes.
qs.en: Citizens want their elected members to be accountable.

qs.s: Cet ___ local s'est engagé à améliorer les transports publics.
qs.en: This elected member committed to improving public transport.

qs.s: Ces conseillers municipaux, tous ___, se réunissent chaque lundi.
qs.en: These municipal councillors, all elected, meet every Monday.

qs.s: Les représentants ___ ont voté la nouvelle loi à l'unanimité.
qs.en: The elected representatives voted unanimously for the new law.

qs.en: The elected MP took up her duties the day after the vote.

qs.en: She is elected president of the association for the third time.

qs.en: The elected councillors, meeting in session, defended this project with passion.

qs.s: Ces deux femmes ___ représentent leur quartier depuis dix ans.
qs.en: These two elected women have represented their neighbourhood for ten years.

qs.s: La France mise beaucoup sur le ___ pour dynamiser son économie.
qs.en: France relies heavily on tourism to boost its economy.

qs.s: Le ___ représente une part importante du PIB de nombreux pays méditerranéens.
qs.en: Tourism represents an important share of the GDP of many Mediterranean countries.

qs.s: Pendant nos vacances à Rome, nous avons fait du ___ toute la journée.
qs.en: During our vacation in Rome, we went sightseeing all day.

qs.s: Mon oncle adore le ___ ; il visite toujours les monuments et les musées quand il voyage.
qs.en: My uncle loves sightseeing; he always visits monuments and museums when he travels.

qs.s: ___ tourisme est l'un des secteurs les plus importants de l'économie française.
qs.en: Tourism is one of the most important sectors of the French economy.

qs.s: Elle a décidé de travailler dans ___ tourisme après ses études.
qs.en: She decided to work in tourism after her studies.

qs.en: The head chef gave a demonstration to show how to prepare this dish.

qs.en: The trainer gave a live demonstration in front of all the trainees.

qs.en: The student followed each step of the mathematical proof on the board.

qs.en: This philosopher put forward a rigorous proof of the existence of God.

qs.s: Des milliers de personnes ont participé à la ___ contre la réforme des retraites.
qs.en: Thousands of people took part in the demonstration against the pension reform.

qs.en: The organizers submitted a file to the prefecture to authorize the trade union demonstration.

qs.s: C'était ___ démonstration de force qui a impressionné tout le monde.
qs.en: It was a show of strength that impressed everyone.

qs.s: Il a suivi ___ démonstration avec beaucoup d'attention.
qs.en: He followed the demonstration with great attention.
